claims.claim: No lint growth versus the base branch.

measurement.instrument: lint run on both trees, compared by error count
measurement.result: Re-run from the correct directory: 4 new errors.

claims.root_cause: The comparison ran from the wrong working directory, so the linter silently dropped its config and both runs linted nothing. 'Same output on both sides' was read as 'no growth'.

retraction.text: Retracted: the lint comparison was invalid, not clean. Real result is 4 new errors.

durable_fix.description: Comparison script exits non-zero when either run loaded zero config files or checked zero files.
durable_fix.evidence: commit 'lint-compare: refuse empty runs' plus a test that plants a missing config

measurement.instrument: same command, with the exit status of each pipeline stage printed
measurement.result: The test runner exited 1; the pipeline reported 0 because its last stage was `tee`.

claims.root_cause: Read the exit status of the last pipeline stage (a log writer) as the status of the test runner.

retraction.text: Retracted: tests do not pass. 3 failures, hidden by the pipeline's exit status.

durable_fix.description: Shell wrapper for test runs sets pipefail and reports the runner's own status; bare pipelines into tee are rejected by a lint rule.

claims.claim: The change has landed on the main branch.

measurement.instrument: git branch --contains <commit> on the main branch
measurement.result: Commit is reachable only from a side branch.

claims.true_value: committed on a side branch, not on main
claims.root_cause: The merge was the plan and the commit exists, so 'landed' was stated from the plan without checking where the commit was reachable.

retraction.text: Retracted: the change is not on main. Merge is still pending.

durable_fix.description: Hand-off template has no free-text 'landed' field; it embeds the output of a reachability check against main.

measurement.result: Endpoint returns 503; the last 200 was 6 hours earlier.

claims.true_value: unhealthy since about 6 hours before the claim
claims.root_cause: Restated a value from an earlier report without re-reading it, and without a timestamp that would have exposed its age.

retraction.text: Retracted: the service was down when this was written.

durable_fix.description: Status lines are generated from a probe that prints the read time; hand-typed status values are rejected in summaries.

claims.claim: Only two call sites use the deprecated function.

measurement.instrument: full-tree search with the output limit removed
measurement.result: The tool showed the first 2 of 11 matches; there are 11 call sites.

claims.root_cause: Counted the rows shown by a tool that truncates output, and treated the truncated page as the whole result.

retraction.text: Retracted: there are 11 call sites, not 2.

durable_fix.description: Search wrapper prints 'N of M shown' and exits non-zero when it truncated.
durable_fix.evidence: commit 'search: fail on truncation' plus a test with a 50-result fixture

claims.claim: About a third of internal links are broken.

measurement.instrument: same link checker, run against one link known to resolve
measurement.result: The checker marked the known-good link as broken.

claims.root_cause: The checker's anchor-slug rule differed from the renderer's. It was never run against a link known to work, so its first output was published as a finding.

retraction.text: Retracted: the figure came from a faulty checker. Real count is 2 of 140.

durable_fix.description: Measurement helper refuses to print a count until its pattern matches a positive control; exits 'unproven' otherwise.
